notes: FROZEN (agent=yes, daemon=incapable, driver=ready/moot). GitHub Copilot IS a subscription product and the CLI knows its own plan — access_type_sku / copilot_plan on authInfo.copilotUser, free_limited_copilot gating /delegate, /usage rendering the entitlement from an authenticated CAPI call — but NONE of that reaches the daemon. The decisive citation is GitHub's own schemas/session-events.schema.json: assistant.usage, the ONLY event referencing AssistantUsageQuotaSnapshot (isUnlimitedEntitlement/entitlementRequests/usedRequests/remainingPercentage/resetDate/overageEntitlement), carries `ephemeral: const true`, documented there as 'Always true for events that are transient and not persisted to the session event log on disk'. Of the 51 persisted event types, NONE carries a plan tier, SKU, entitlement or remaining budget — only sessionLimits.maxAiCredits (a user-configured per-session soft cap, not an entitlement), contextTier (a context-window tier, not a billing plan), and the totalNanoAiu/totalPremiumRequests consumption counters. Confirmed empirically: a type census across all 6 local ~/.copilot/session-state/*/events.jsonl files yields 16 distinct types, a strict subset of the persisted list, with zero assistant.usage; and a whole-tree grep of ~/.copilot for plan/sku/entitlement/remaining-budget fields matches nothing (config.json has no such field; session-store.db has total_nano_aiu and request_multiplier but no plan column; the 'sku' hits in logs/ are base64 substrings inside MCP icon PNGs). The adapter tails events.jsonl and nothing else (copilot/agent.go:38-44) and wires NEITHER of irrlicht's two RateLimitSnapshot transports — claudecode's out-of-band statusline POST (statusline.go:113-145) nor codex's in-band JSONL rate_limits field (codex/parser.go:489-508); a grep of the adapter for ratelimit|statusline|quota|plan_type|credit|entitlement matches six comment lines and zero handlers. So no per-session RateLimitSnapshot can ever be produced for a copilot session: incapable (no trace exists), not bug (nothing is mis-handled) and not gap (the driver has every step type). Separately, irrlicht's subscription surface is keyed to anthropic/openai throughout — providerForSession (cost_tracker.go:68-77), donorKey/recipientKey (quotainherit.go:238-275), quotaChips.js providerKeyFor (L42-54), SessionState.swift providerKey (L274-285) — and copilot maps to NEITHER; the #1256 plan deliberately excluded adding it because Copilot bills in AI credits rather than a provider quota window. Cost for copilot goes through the shared general token pricing path (capacity/aliases.go -> EstimatedCostUSD) like every other adapter, which settles COST and is orthogonal to this cell's SUBSCRIPTION DETECTION question. No lifecycle phases while frozen. Observations are zeroed because no recording is produced — not a claim about the adapter, which does report tokens and cost (see the 5-1 token-accounting cell). Re-assess only if a future Copilot release persists the quota snapshot (or a plan/sku field) onto a non-ephemeral event, or ships a statusline-style hook, AND the copilot adapter grows matching ingestion. Verified against CLI 1.0.77.
